description: The official-chat content webviews are remote origins (DeepSeek chat, Qianwen, and MiniMax agent), so Tauri's ACL denies their invokes by default. No shell commands are wired here: the lamp that raises the management panel lives on the local strip webview (see official-chat-strip.json), so the content pages themselves stay read-only as far as the shell is concerned. The URLs are intentionally exact (not wildcards) so only those three origins — not the marketing sites or any future sub-app — can drive IPC.
